systemic_note: The same root cause as the pilot's G1/G3/G5/G6: the 1.21.7 tree carries 26.x API forms (packages, constructors, mechanics) for things that do not exist in vanilla 1.21.7, and every such reference fails loudly at javac time in the oracles (unlike the port code, where the same pattern silently degrades). The measurement found no purely mechanical repair group: zero files fail ONLY on missing-package, so each remaining file needs per-API translation verified against the 1.21.7 jar. Two systemic facts for the coordinator: (1) the 1.21.11 behaviour branch repaired only 16 oracle files, so there is no systematic repair to inherit — MobAi's 1.21.11 diff was Identifier renames only; (2) compiling is not running — the runtime layer (O8) is unmeasured and each oracle needs an end-to-end driver run.
